note: _advivere_ (Clementina, Weber/Gryson) – to be still alive; noch leben. The verb is not to be changed into _adhuc viveret_ (a reading of many printed editions, adopted in Loch’s 1863 edition of the Vulgate, and by Loch rendered as “solange er lebte” – as long as he lived), see the discussion in Kaulen (p. 202). Since the expression is unusual, NVg has _omnibus diebus vitae suae_ – all the days of his life.
